neighbours.label: the property word that says in which sense a term is meant, when a word's meaning is being glossed ('free' in 'does not mean free of charge', 'low' in 'mean low in calories')
fire: In this licence the word "libre" does not mean free of charge.
When bakers say "short pastry" they mean rich in fat, not small in size.
The phrase "open access" here does not mean free of all restrictions.
By "soft water" plumbers mean low in minerals, not gentle to touch.
On this menu the word "complimentary" does mean free of charge.
When printers say "heavy paper" they mean high in weight per sheet.
The label "gratis" on the shelf means free of any cost to members.
By "fresh fish" the stall means free of ice and caught that morning.
